terms.title: Terms of Service
body: By using Wellness, you agree to use the app for its intended purpose: tracking your strength, running and nutrition activities.
You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you enter. Wellness does not provide medical advice; consult a health professional before any training or diet program.
Your account is personal. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential.
The minimum age to create an account is 16.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
body: We only collect the data needed to run the app: account (email), profile and the activity data you enter.
Your data is isolated per user and securely synced to the cloud. It is never sold to third parties.
Health and location data are never shared without your explicit consent.

We measure app usage (screens viewed, features used) through anonymous statistics, solely to improve it; these measurements never include your health data and you can turn them off at any time from settings.
You can request an export or deletion of your data at any time from settings.

help.title: Help & support

items.a: Yes. Your data is saved on the device and syncs automatically as soon as a connection is available.

items.q: Is my data synced across my devices?
items.a: Yes: sign in with the same account and your data syncs in the background.

items.q: How do I enable or disable a pillar (Strength / Running / Nutrition)?
items.a: In Settings → Active pillars. Tabs for disabled pillars are hidden and reappear when you re-enable them.

items.q: How do I change the units or the language?
How do I export my data?
items.a: In Settings → Export my data: you get a complete copy of your data as JSON.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: In Settings → Danger zone → Delete my account. A 30-day grace period lets you undo it.
Yes, the app is entirely free.
